measurement_note: Size is n, the sequence length. The accepted formula performs constant work at every tier. A correct cube-block accumulation alternative groups the pairwise gain into blocks of roughly n^(2/3) terms and performs O(cuberoot(n)) additions; these tiers expose that unnecessary growth while keeping every legal input below the safety cap.
